original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚执政党APC抨击阿马埃奇称无力负担母亲药费的说法
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚全体进步大会党（APC）发表声明，抨击前河流州州长、前交通部长罗蒂米·阿马埃奇关于在蒂努布政府经济困境下无力为已故母亲购买药物的说法。APC还质疑阿马埃奇是否适合在2027年担任尼日利亚副总统。阿马埃奇目前是非洲民主大会党（ADC）的副总统候选人，他此前在电视采访中指责蒂努布的经济政策导致其难以购买母亲所需药物。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚执政党APC抨击前交通部长阿马埃奇关于无力负担母亲药费的说法
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: THE All Progressives Congress (APC) has attacked former Rivers State governor and ex-Minister of Transportation, Rotimi Amaechi, over his claim that economic hardship under President Bola Tinubu's administration made it difficult for him to afford medication for his late mother.

key_facts.fact: APC质疑阿马埃奇是否适合在2027年担任尼日利亚副总统
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: also questioned Amaechi's suitability to serve as Nigeria's vice president in 2027

key_facts.fact: 阿马埃奇是非洲民主大会党（ADC）的副总统候选人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Amaechi, the vice-presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC)

key_facts.fact: 阿马埃奇称蒂努布的政策导致其难以购买母亲所需药物
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Tinubu's policies killed my mother. Before Tinubu came, my mother was healthy. After 2023, it was difficult for me to buy drugs for my mother

key_facts.fact: 阿马埃奇的母亲埃津内·阿马埃奇于7月16日去世，享年89岁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Amaechi's mother, Ezinne Amaechi, died on July 16 at the age of 89.

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源，尚未获得交叉验证
阿马埃奇关于经济困难导致无力购药的说法为其个人声称，未获独立证实
